name: Opdenergy Holding, S.A.
summary: As an independent producer of renewable energy, Opdenergy Holding, S.A. undertakes the complete process of generating electricity. This includes the conceptualization, development, construction, ongoing management, and upkeep of its power-producing assets. The firm's main emphasis is on producing energy from solar photovoltaic installations and land-based wind facilities. Founded in 2005, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in Madrid, Spain.
